items.headline: Microsoft Releases Preliminary Report on Recent 365 Service Outage
items.summary: Microsoft issued a preliminary post-incident report attributing the recent Microsoft 365 service disruption to a latent software defect and network capacity issues.

items.headline: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Officer Sells $8.37 Million in Common Stock
items.summary: Charles F. Wagner Jr., an officer at Vertex Pharmaceuticals, sold 15,300 shares of common stock valued at approximately $8.37 million.

items.headline: Teamsters Organize Rally for Terminated Amazon Delivery Drivers in New York City
items.summary: The Teamsters union is organizing a rally to support 200 delivery drivers who were dismissed after Amazon terminated its contract with their third-party employer.

items.headline: Instagram Launches Integration for Amazon Affiliate Links
items.summary: Instagram has introduced a new feature allowing creators to directly integrate Amazon affiliate links into Reels and feed posts.

items.headline: BlackRock Reports Change in Voting Rights in Smiths Group
items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. disclosed a reduction in its total voting rights in Smiths Group, moving from 12.97% to 12.61%.

items.headline: BlackRock Investment Institute Warns of Potential AI Buildout Slowdown Impact
items.summary: Jean Boivin, head of the BlackRock Investment Institute, highlighted the risk that a deceleration in AI infrastructure investment could have material consequences for U.S. economic growth.

items.headline: Amnesty International Reports Continued Labor Issues at Amazon Saudi Arabia Facilities
items.summary: Amnesty International has alleged that migrant workers at Amazon facilities in Saudi Arabia continue to face exploitation, including misleading recruitment practices and wage issues.

items.headline: Court Grants Intervention in Broadcom and VMware Legal Case
items.summary: The President of the Fourth Chamber of the General Court has granted the ACC leave to intervene in support of Broadcom and VMware in Case T-280/26.

items.headline: NVIDIA Announces Quantum Computing Collaborations with IBM and Fermilab
items.summary: NVIDIA is partnering with IBM and the Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory to advance quantum computing research, including a new modular codesign platform and a high-speed decoding algorithm.

items.headline: NVIDIA Introduces Nemotron for Science Platform
items.summary: NVIDIA launched 'NVIDIA Nemotron for Science,' a new platform designed to help researchers build specialized AI agents for scientific discovery, including a new chemistry dataset.

items.headline: NVIDIA Launches Vera CPU Platform for High-Performance Computing
items.summary: NVIDIA announced the 'NVIDIA Vera CPU' rack-scale platform, its first custom data center CPU designed for high-performance scientific modeling and simulation.

items.headline: Thread AI Joins Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program
items.summary: Thread AI has been accepted into the Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program, providing the company with access to Azure AI models and enterprise-grade support.

items.headline: Microsoft Addresses Recent 365 Service Disruption
items.summary: Microsoft has implemented new service health check methods and automated recovery systems following a global disruption to its 365 services that occurred between November 12 and 14, 2026.

items.headline: TD Cowen Adjusts Broadcom Price Target to $425 From $475
items.summary: TD Cowen has revised its price target for Broadcom Inc. to $425, down from the previous target of $475.

items.headline: XP Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: XP Inc. announced its financial results for the third quarter of 2026, highlighting growth in total client assets and key operating metrics.

items.headline: Analysts Update Ratings on Richemont Following Fiscal H1 Results
items.summary: Financial analysts from Berenberg, Goldman Sachs, and RBC have issued updated ratings and commentary on Richemont following the company's fiscal first-half results.

items.headline: Tencent Music Entertainment Group Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: Tencent Music Entertainment Group reported its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026, showing growth in revenue.

items.headline: ING Group and Amundi Launch New ETFs
items.summary: ING Group has partnered with Amundi to launch a new series of exchange-traded funds (ETFs).

items.headline: Allianz SE Reports Share Buyback Progress
items.summary: Allianz SE disclosed that it repurchased 13,700 shares between November 9 and November 13, 2026, as part of its ongoing 2026 share buyback program.

items.headline: Silicon Motion Showcases ASPEED-Integrated Storage Solutions at SC26
items.summary: Silicon Motion is demonstrating its Ferri-eMMC embedded storage solution integrated with ASPEED's AST2600 Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) at the Supercomputing 2026 (SC26) conference.

items.headline: Novartis Cosentyx Receives FDA Approval for Polymyalgia Rheumatica
items.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved Novartis's Cosentyx for the treatment of polymyalgia rheumatica (PMR).

items.headline: MIXUE Group Participates in China-Thailand Business Forum
items.summary: MIXUE Group executive Zhang Yuan represented the company at the China-Thailand Business Forum in Bangkok to discuss regional economic cooperation and supply chain integration.

items.headline: JD.com Announces Unaudited Financial Results for the Third Quarter of 2026
items.summary: JD.com, Inc. reported its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, with net revenues reaching RMB309.6 billion.

items.headline: Silicon Motion Showcases Next-Generation Enterprise Storage Solutions at SC26
items.summary: Silicon Motion is demonstrating its new PCIe Gen5 and PCIe Gen6 MonTitan enterprise SSD controllers and reference platforms at the Supercomputing 2026 (SC26) conference in Chicago.

items.headline: Maybank Securities Acts as Sub-Placement Agent for HomesToLife Ltd
items.summary: Maybank Securities Pte. Ltd. served as a sub-placement agent for a recent placement by Singapore-based home furniture company HomesToLife Ltd.

items.headline: BASF Agricultural Solutions Publishes Report on Agricultural Decarbonization
items.summary: BASF Agricultural Solutions has released a new report titled 'Advancing Agricultural Decarbonization: From Field to Food Value Chain' detailing strategies for reducing carbon emissions in agriculture.

items.headline: Bernstein Research Adjusts Price Target for Merck KGaA
items.summary: Bernstein Research has raised its price target for Merck KGaA from 151 to 178 Euro while maintaining a 'Market-Perform' rating.

items.headline: AXA Partners with St. James' Settlement to Launch FutureMinds Project
items.summary: AXA has collaborated with St. James' Settlement to introduce the FutureMinds project, aimed at enhancing youth mental resilience and promoting healthy digital habits.

items.headline: NIO Inc. Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release
items.summary: NIO Inc. announced it will report its unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, on December 1, 2026.

items.headline: Bernstein Research Maintains 'Outperform' Rating on Safran
items.summary: Bernstein Research has reiterated its 'Outperform' rating for Safran with a price target of 390 euros.

items.headline: Director's Dealing: Board Member Andrew Buchanan Acquires Shares
items.summary: Munich Re board member Andrew Buchanan has acquired company shares in a transaction reported on November 17, 2026.

items.headline: Zurich Insurance Raises Growth and Synergy Outlook for Beazley Acquisition
items.summary: Zurich Insurance Group has increased its medium-term revenue and synergy projections following its acquisition of the British specialty insurer Beazley.

items.headline: BNP Paribas Acts as Stabilisation Coordinator for Eutelsat Communications Notes Offering
items.summary: BNP Paribas has been appointed as the stabilisation coordinator for a EUR 400 million notes offering by Eutelsat Communications, with a stabilisation period beginning on November 17, 2026.

items.headline: Haier Smart Home Outlines Climate Action Strategy at COP31
items.summary: Haier Smart Home presented its vision for sustainable living at the COP31 climate conference, focusing on five key pathways for low-carbon and circular home solutions.

items.headline: Société Générale Opens Representative Office in Uzbekistan
items.summary: Société Générale has established a representative office in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, following accreditation by the Central Bank of Uzbekistan.

items.headline: Equinor ASA Provides Update on 2026 Share Buy-Back Program
items.summary: Equinor ASA has released details regarding transactions executed under the fourth tranche of its 2026 share buy-back program.

items.headline: UniCredit CEO Andrea Orcel Comments on Banking Sector Taxation and Competitive Asymmetry
items.summary: UniCredit CEO Andrea Orcel criticized the disproportionate tax burden on banks in Italy and highlighted concerns regarding competitive asymmetry in the banking sector.

items.headline: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix Report Significant Increase in Cash Reserves and R&D Spending
items.summary: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix have significantly increased their cash reserves and R&D expenditures, driven by strong demand for AI-related memory chips.

items.headline: MINISO Group Announces Unaudited Financial Results for the Third Quarter and Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026
items.summary: MINISO Group Holding Limited reported its unaudited financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, highlighting revenue growth and store network expansion.

items.headline: Capri Holdings Insider Sold Shares Worth $46.9 Million
items.summary: A corporate insider at Capri Holdings Limited executed a sale of company shares valued at approximately $46.9 million, according to a recent SEC filing.
